korean_translation: 매니저한테 그 얘기 할 기회가 있었어?

english_expression: If you don't mind me asking how did you two meet?
key_expression: If you don't mind me asking
korean_translation: 이런 걸 여쭤봐도 될지 모르겠지만, 두 분은 어떻게 만나셨어요?

english_expression: With all due respect I think we're missing the bigger picture.
korean_translation: 외람된 말씀이지만 더 큰 그림을 놓치고 있는 것 같아요.

english_expression: Can you send this over by today if possible?
korean_translation: 가능하다면 오늘 중으로 보내줄 수 있어?

english_expression: I was wondering if you'd have time to look over my resume.
korean_translation: 제 이력서를 검토할 시간이 있으실지 궁금했어요.

english_expression: No problem at all. It was my pleasure.
korean_translation: 전혀요. 제가 더 좋았는걸요.

english_expression: I hope you're doing well. It's been a while since we last spoke.
korean_translation: 잘 지내고 계시길 바랍니다. 마지막으로 연락한 지 꽤 됐네요.

english_expression: I hope you're having a great week so far. Just wanted to check in.
korean_translation: 이번 주도 좋은 한 주 보내고 계시길 바랍니다. 안부 전하려고 연락드렸어요.

english_expression: It's so great to hear from you. It's been ages!
key_expression: It's so great to hear from you
korean_translation: 연락이 와서 너무 반가워. 정말 오랜만이다!

english_expression: Oh my gosh what a nice surprise! I didn't know you were coming.
korean_translation: 세상에 이런 반가운 일이! 올 줄 몰랐어.

english_expression: Please see the attached invoice for your reference.
korean_translation: 참고용으로 첨부한 청구서를 확인 부탁드립니다.

english_expression: I'll CC the rest of the team so everyone's up to date.
korean_translation: 모두가 최신 내용을 알 수 있도록 팀 전체를 참조인으로 추가할게요.

english_expression: Can you forward me the original email thread?
korean_translation: 원래 이메일 스레드 저한테 전달해줄 수 있어요?

english_expression: I just wanted to follow up and see if you'd had a chance to review the proposal.
korean_translation: 제안서 검토할 기회가 있으셨는지 확인차 연락드렸어요.

english_expression: Do you have any follow-up questions I can help with?
korean_translation: 제가 도움드릴 수 있는 추가 질문이 있으신가요?

english_expression: Is it okay if I bring a friend to the party?
korean_translation: 파티에 친구를 데려와도 괜찮을까요?

english_expression: Please note that the office will be operating on reduced hours next week.
korean_translation: 다음 주에 사무실이 단축 운영된다는 점 참고 부탁드립니다.

english_expression: I'll make a note of your preference for future reference.
korean_translation: 향후 참고를 위해 선호하시는 점을 메모해두겠습니다.

english_expression: Please submit your application by midnight.
korean_translation: 자정까지 지원서를 제출해주세요.

english_expression: I'll be at my desk until 6 PM if you need to reach me.
korean_translation: 저는 오후 6시까지 자리에 있을 거예요. 연락 필요하시면 주세요.

english_expression: Do you have any further concerns before we proceed?
korean_translation: 진행하기 전에 추가 우려 사항이 있으신가요?

english_expression: I won't be in the meeting but please keep me in the loop.
korean_translation: 회의에는 못 가지만 진행 상황 계속 알려줘.

english_expression: I've attached a few examples. I hope this helps!
korean_translation: 예시 몇 가지를 첨부했어요. 도움이 됐으면 좋겠습니다!

english_expression: I don't have an answer right now but I'll get back to you as soon as I can.
key_expression: I'll get back to you as soon as I can
korean_translation: 지금 당장 답변 드리기 어렵지만 최대한 빨리 연락드릴게요.

english_expression: She's turning 30 next month. We're planning a surprise party.
korean_translation: 그녀가 다음 달에 30살이 돼. 깜짝 파티를 계획하고 있어.

english_expression: Wait your turn! Everyone will get a chance.
korean_translation: 차례 기다려! 다들 기회가 있을 거야.

english_expression: The business was struggling but things are starting to turn around.
korean_translation: 사업이 힘들었는데 상황이 나아지기 시작하고 있어.

english_expression: I really hope things work out for you in your new city.
korean_translation: 새 도시에서 다 잘 풀리길 진심으로 바라.

english_expression: We were nervous about the party but it turned out amazing.
korean_translation: 파티가 걱정됐는데 결과적으로 정말 멋졌어.

english_expression: What started as a small argument turned into a big fight.
korean_translation: 작은 다툼으로 시작한 게 결국 큰 싸움이 됐어.

english_expression: Can you turn off the lights on your way out?
korean_translation: 나갈 때 불 꺼줄 수 있어?

english_expression: I can barely hear the TV. Can you turn it up a bit?
korean_translation: TV 소리가 거의 안 들려. 좀 키워줄 수 있어?

english_expression: She turned down the promotion because of the commute.
korean_translation: 출퇴근 때문에 승진 제안을 거절했어.

english_expression: I'm gonna have to cancel our plans tonight. I'm so sorry.
korean_translation: 오늘 밤 약속을 취소해야 할 것 같아. 정말 미안해.

english_expression: That message you sent me this morning really made my day.
key_expression: you sent me this morning really made my day
korean_translation: 오늘 아침에 보내준 그 메시지가 정말 하루를 기분 좋게 만들어줬어.

english_expression: The original file got deleted so I had to start from scratch.
korean_translation: 원본 파일이 삭제돼서 처음부터 다시 시작해야 했어.

english_expression: The budget is limited but we'll make it work somehow.
korean_translation: 예산이 제한적이지만 어떻게든 되게 할게.

english_expression: This is not your decision to make. Please let the team decide.
korean_translation: 네가 내릴 결정이 아니야. 팀이 결정하도록 해줘.

english_expression: I don't feel comfortable going alone. Can you come with me?
korean_translation: 혼자 가기가 좀 불편해. 같이 가줄 수 있어?

english_expression: Is the training session mandatory or optional this time?
korean_translation: 이번 교육은 의무인가요 아니면 선택인가요?

english_expression: We're making every effort to deliver the project on time.
korean_translation: 프로젝트를 제때 납품하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있어요.

english_expression: You only get two weeks off a year. Make the most of it.
korean_translation: 일 년에 휴가가 2주밖에 없잖아. 최대한 잘 써야 해.

english_expression: Make sure you get there early to save us seats.
korean_translation: 자리 잡아두게 일찍 가도록 해.

english_expression: Before we finalize I'd love to get your input on this.
korean_translation: 확정하기 전에 이 부분에 대한 네 의견을 꼭 듣고 싶어.

english_expression: Is there any way to expedite the approval process?
korean_translation: 승인 절차를 더 빨리 진행할 수 있는 방법이 있을까요?

english_expression: Sorry I haven't replied sooner. I've been completely swamped.
korean_translation: 더 빨리 답장 못 해서 미안. 정말 정신없이 바빴어.

english_expression: I can't take on anything new right now. I'm absolutely slammed.
korean_translation: 지금 새로운 건 맡을 수 없어. 완전히 할 일이 가득해.

english_expression: You finished it on time despite everything. Give yourself a pat on the back.
key_expression: Give yourself a pat on the back
korean_translation: 그 모든 상황에도 제때 끝냈잖아. 스스로 잘했다고 칭찬해줘.

english_expression: Thank you for everything. I truly couldn't have done this without you.
key_expression: couldn't have done this without you
korean_translation: 모든 것에 감사해. 정말 너 없이는 할 수 없었을 거야.

english_expression: The new bakery is just down the street from my office.
korean_translation: 사무실에서 길 아래 바로 새 빵집이 생겼어.

english_expression: The skills you're learning now will pay off down the road.
korean_translation: 지금 배우고 있는 기술들이 앞으로 도움이 될 거야.

english_expression: Eating healthy is hard now but it pays off in the long run.
korean_translation: 지금은 건강하게 먹는 게 힘들지만 장기적으로 보면 효과가 있어.

english_expression: I'm so frustrated with this slow internet connection.
korean_translation: 인터넷이 너무 느려서 짜증나.

english_expression: I called my teacher 'mom' in front of the whole class. I was so embarrassed.
korean_translation: 반 전체 앞에서 선생님을 '엄마'라고 불렀어. 너무 민망했어.

english_expression: He was devastated when his proposal got rejected.
korean_translation: 프로포즈가 거절당했을 때 그는 망연자실했어.

english_expression: I can tell you're upset. Do you want to talk about it?
korean_translation: 화난 거 알 것 같아. 얘기하고 싶어?

english_expression: She was humiliated when her boss corrected her in front of everyone.
korean_translation: 상사가 모든 사람 앞에서 그녀를 지적했을 때 굴욕적이었어.

english_expression: It was great catching up but I gotta run. Let's do this again!
korean_translation: 얘기 나눠서 좋았는데 가봐야 해. 또 만나자!

english_expression: I need to run a quick errand. I'll meet you there.
korean_translation: 잠깐 볼일 보고 올게. 거기서 만나자.

english_expression: I've been running around all day trying to get ready for the trip.
korean_translation: 여행 준비하느라 하루 종일 이리저리 뛰어다녔어.

english_expression: While the director is away I'll be in charge.
korean_translation: 감독이 없는 동안 제가 담당할게요.

english_expression: Sorry, the previous call ran late. I'll be there in 5.
korean_translation: 죄송해요, 이전 통화가 늦게 끝났어요. 5분 안에 갈게요.

english_expression: I ran into my college roommate at the airport.
korean_translation: 공항에서 대학교 룸메이트를 우연히 만났어.

english_expression: We ran into some unexpected delays with the shipment.
korean_translation: 배송에 예상치 못한 지연이 생겼어.

english_expression: I ran across an old friend while traveling in Europe.
korean_translation: 유럽 여행 중에 오랜 친구를 우연히 만났어.

english_expression: I ran across a really helpful tip while reading online.
korean_translation: 인터넷 검색하다가 정말 유용한 팁을 우연히 발견했어.

english_expression: Before I send this can I run it by you quickly?
korean_translation: 이거 보내기 전에 빠르게 네 의견을 물어봐도 될까?

english_expression: We're running out of coffee. Someone needs to make a run.
korean_translation: 커피가 다 떨어지고 있어. 누군가 사러 가야 할 것 같아.

english_expression: Let's quickly run through the key points before the meeting.
korean_translation: 회의 전에 핵심 내용을 빠르게 훑어보자.

english_expression: Bear with me for a second. I just need to find the right slide.
korean_translation: 잠깐만 기다려주세요. 슬라이드를 찾아야 해서요.

english_expression: It's not that complicated. I'll show you.
korean_translation: 그렇게 복잡하지 않아. 보여줄게.

english_expression: The traffic was bad earlier but it's not that bad now.
korean_translation: 아까 교통이 막혔는데 지금은 그렇게 나쁘지 않아.

english_expression: You drove me home last time. I owe you dinner.
korean_translation: 저번에 집에 바래다줬잖아. 내가 저녁 살게.

english_expression: I owe you an explanation. That wasn't fair.
korean_translation: 설명을 해야 할 것 같아. 그건 공평하지 않았어.

english_expression: We need to hit the road early if we want to beat traffic.
korean_translation: 교통 막히기 전에 일찍 출발해야 해.

english_expression: He really appreciates the effort you put into this.
korean_translation: 그는 네가 이 일에 쏟은 노력의 진가를 정말 알아봐.

english_expression: I really appreciate you taking the time to meet with me.
korean_translation: 시간 내어 만나주셔서 정말 감사합니다.

english_expression: The color is blue-ish. It's hard to describe exactly.
korean_translation: 색이 약간 파란색 같아. 정확히 설명하기 어려워.

english_expression: Is there enough room in the car for all of us?
korean_translation: 차에 우리 모두가 탈 공간이 충분해?

english_expression: Leave some room. We're getting dessert later.
korean_translation: 좀 남겨놔. 나중에 디저트 먹을 거야.

english_expression: There's no room for mistakes on this one.
korean_translation: 이번엔 실수할 여유가 없어.

english_expression: Your writing is strong but there's always room for improvement.
korean_translation: 글쓰기 실력은 좋은데 항상 개선할 여지는 있지.

english_expression: She nailed the audition. I think she's going to get the part.
korean_translation: 오디션을 완벽하게 해냈어. 그 역할을 따낼 것 같아.

english_expression: That was an impressive comeback in the second half.
korean_translation: 후반전에 인상적인 역전이었어.

english_expression: After all those years of hard work you deserve this success.
korean_translation: 그 몇 년 동안의 노력 끝에 이 성공을 누릴 자격이 있어.

english_expression: Atta boy! That's the fastest you've ever run.
korean_translation: 잘했어! 이제까지 가장 빨리 달린 거야.

english_expression: Let me update my resume before I start applying.
korean_translation: 지원하기 전에 이력서를 업데이트해야겠어.

english_expression: The package is supposed to arrive by Friday.
korean_translation: 패키지가 금요일까지 도착하기로 되어 있어.

english_expression: We were supposed to finish this yesterday.
korean_translation: 우리 어제까지 이걸 끝내기로 되어 있었는데.

english_expression: If the system crashes what am I supposed to do?
key_expression: what am I supposed to do?
korean_translation: 시스템이 충돌하면 내가 뭘 해야 해?

english_expression: You said 'we'll see.' What's that supposed to mean?
korean_translation: '두고 보자'고 했는데 그게 무슨 뜻이야?

english_expression: I'm between jobs right now but I'm actively looking.
korean_translation: 지금은 구직 중이지만 열심히 찾고 있어.

english_expression: Here's my card. Let's keep in touch.
korean_translation: 명함 드릴게요. 계속 연락해요.

english_expression: The chef sent out an extra dish. It's on the house.
korean_translation: 셰프가 추가 요리를 보내줬어. 서비스래.

english_expression: It's your birthday. Everything is my treat today.
korean_translation: 오늘 네 생일이잖아. 오늘은 다 내가 살게.

english_expression: Meeting my best friends was the best thing about college.
korean_translation: 가장 친한 친구들을 만난 게 대학 시절 최고의 일이었어.

english_expression: She's out of the office this week. I'll have her contact you.
korean_translation: 이번 주에 자리를 비우셨어요. 연락드리라고 할게요.

english_expression: Are you a morning person? I can never wake up early.
korean_translation: 아침형 인간이야? 나는 일찍 일어나는 게 너무 힘들어.

english_expression: I'm thinking about taking a semester off to travel.
korean_translation: 여행하려고 한 학기 휴학할까 생각 중이야.

english_expression: She's on maternity leave so I'm covering for her.
korean_translation: 그녀가 출산 휴가 중이라서 내가 대신하고 있어.

english_expression: This is time-sensitive. Can you put everything else on hold?
korean_translation: 이건 급한 일이야. 다른 건 잠깐 미뤄도 될까?

english_expression: The team delivered a great turnaround on a really tight deadline.
korean_translation: 팀이 매우 촉박한 마감에도 빠르게 훌륭하게 처리했어.

english_expression: She's always so responsive. I get a reply within minutes.
korean_translation: 그녀는 항상 빠르게 반응해. 몇 분 안에 답장이 와.

english_expression: Hey you wanted to see me? I just got your message.
korean_translation: 안녕하세요, 부르셨어요? 방금 메시지 받았어요.

english_expression: I can't promise anything but I'll see what I can do.
key_expression: I'll see what I can do
korean_translation: 약속은 못 하지만 어떻게 되는지 해볼게요.

english_expression: Do you validate parking for customers?
korean_translation: 고객들 주차 승인해주시나요?

english_expression: Before we wrap up let's do a quick recap of today's decisions.
korean_translation: 마무리하기 전에 오늘 결정 사항들을 빠르게 요약해보자.

english_expression: Where did we leave off last time? I lost my notes.
korean_translation: 저번에 어디까지 했지? 노트를 잃어버렸어.

english_expression: You said there were issues. Could you elaborate a bit more?
korean_translation: 문제가 있다고 했는데 좀 더 자세히 말해줄 수 있어?

english_expression: Could you walk me through the sign-up process?
korean_translation: 가입 절차를 차근차근 설명해줄 수 있나요?

english_expression: I missed the kickoff meeting. Can someone fill me in?
korean_translation: 킥오프 미팅에 못 갔어. 누가 설명해줄 수 있어?

english_expression: Feel free to reach out anytime if you have questions.
korean_translation: 질문이 있으시면 언제든지 편하게 연락 주세요.

english_expression: The proposal is almost there. It just needs a few tweaks.
korean_translation: 제안서가 거의 다 됐어. 몇 가지만 살짝 수정하면 돼.

english_expression: Before deciding let's go over the pros and cons.
korean_translation: 결정하기 전에 장단점을 살펴보자.

english_expression: I need to weigh my options before committing to anything.
korean_translation: 뭔가에 헌신하기 전에 선택지를 잘 따져봐야 해.

english_expression: Finishing the client report is my top priority today.
korean_translation: 오늘 클라이언트 보고서 완성이 1순위야.

english_expression: We need to prioritize the most urgent tasks first.
korean_translation: 가장 긴급한 업무부터 먼저 처리해야 해.

english_expression: I'd be happy to cover your shift if you need a day off.
korean_translation: 네가 하루 쉬어야 한다면 내가 기꺼이 대신할게.

english_expression: The food's here. Enjoy your lunch!
korean_translation: 음식 나왔어요. 맛있게 드세요!

english_expression: Have a great weekend and enjoy the rest of your week!
korean_translation: 좋은 주말 보내고 남은 한 주도 잘 마무리해요!

english_expression: Are you enjoying the new neighborhood?
korean_translation: 새 동네는 마음에 들어?

english_expression: Sorry to keep you waiting. The train was delayed.

english_expression: I got the wrong package. I think there might have been a mix-up.
key_expression: I think there might have been a mix-up
korean_translation: 엉뚱한 물건이 왔어요. 뭔가 착오가 있었던 것 같아요.

english_expression: Our team is facing a budget issue due to recent cost-cutting measures.
key_expression: facing a budget issue due to recent
korean_translation: 비용 절감 조치로 우리 팀이 예산 문제에 직면해 있어.

english_expression: Before we fix anything we need to figure out the root cause first.
korean_translation: 뭔가 고치기 전에 근본 원인부터 파악해야 해.

english_expression: She tried to save money but ended up spending even more.
korean_translation: 돈을 아끼려 했는데 오히려 더 많이 쓰고 말았어.

english_expression: You keep saying you'll come to the gym, but you never do.
key_expression: You keep saying you'll come to the gym, but you never do
korean_translation: 헬스장 간다 간다 하면서 한 번도 안 오잖아.

english_expression: I don't mind working overtime if it helps the team.
korean_translation: 팀에 도움이 된다면 야근하는 것도 괜찮아.

english_expression: Before you move abroad, consider saving up some money first.
key_expression: Before you move abroad, consider saving
korean_translation: 해외로 이사하기 전에 먼저 돈을 좀 모아둬.

english_expression: We need to cut costs. It's a matter of survival right now.
korean_translation: 비용을 줄여야 해. 지금은 살아남는 게 중요해.

english_expression: Could you say that again? I lost track of what you were saying.
key_expression: I lost track of what you were saying
korean_translation: 다시 말해줄 수 있어? 무슨 말 하는지 놓쳤어.

english_expression: It was hard at first but after a week I got the hang of it.
korean_translation: 처음엔 힘들었는데 일주일 지나니 감을 잡았어.

english_expression: It makes sense to take breaks if you want to stay productive.
korean_translation: 생산성을 유지하고 싶다면 쉬는 게 맞아.

english_expression: To put things into perspective, we're still ahead of our competitors.
korean_translation: 큰 그림으로 보면 우리는 아직 경쟁사들보다 앞서 있어.

english_expression: I'm supposed to give a presentation at 3PM.
korean_translation: 나 오후 3시에 발표를 하기로 되어 있어.

english_expression: I've got a plan to get fit before summer.
korean_translation: 여름 전에 몸 만들 계획이 있어.

english_expression: I can't stand sitting in traffic for over an hour.
korean_translation: 한 시간 넘게 교통체증에 갇혀 있는 걸 못 참겠어.

english_expression: I tried to get into classical music but it's just not my cup of tea.
korean_translation: 클래식 음악에 빠져보려 했는데 그냥 내 취향이 아니야.

english_expression: You can't afford to keep delaying this decision any longer.
korean_translation: 더 이상 그 결정을 미룰 여유가 없어.

english_expression: He managed to finish the marathon despite the heat.
korean_translation: 더운 날씨에도 불구하고 마라톤을 완주해냈어.

english_expression: The landlord plans on raising the rent next year.
korean_translation: 집주인이 내년에 월세를 올릴 계획이래.

english_expression: He claimed to be an expert but it turned out he had no experience.
korean_translation: 전문가라고 했는데 알고 보니 경험이 전혀 없었어.

english_expression: She needs a reality check if she thinks this plan will work overnight.
korean_translation: 이 계획이 하룻밤에 될 거라고 생각하면 현실을 직시해야 해.

english_expression: She left early on purpose to avoid running into her ex.
korean_translation: 전 남자친구를 마주치지 않으려고 일부러 일찍 나갔어.

english_expression: Don't ask me to do anything extra. I'm completely swamped right now.
korean_translation: 추가 업무는 부탁하지 마. 지금 일이 너무 밀려 있어.

english_expression: Your coding skills might come in handy for this project.
korean_translation: 네 코딩 실력이 이 프로젝트에서 도움이 될 수도 있어.

english_expression: The bus stopped running so I had no choice but to call a cab.
korean_translation: 버스가 끊겨서 택시를 부를 수밖에 없었어.

english_expression: She goes as far as to drive two hours just to see her family.
korean_translation: 그녀는 가족을 보기 위해 두 시간씩 운전하는 것도 마다하지 않아.

english_expression: I never saw losing my job coming like that.
key_expression: never saw losing my job coming
korean_translation: 그렇게 갑자기 직장을 잃게 될 줄 몰랐어.

english_expression: He's really big on fitness. He goes to the gym every single day.
korean_translation: 그는 운동에 진심이야. 매일 헬스장에 가.

english_expression: Saving money every month is easier said than done.
korean_translation: 매달 돈을 저금하는 건 말은 쉽지.

english_expression: She learned to code from scratch and landed a tech job.
korean_translation: 코딩을 처음부터 독학해서 IT 회사에 취업했어.

english_expression: I take pride in never being late to work.
korean_translation: 직장에 한 번도 늦은 적 없는 게 내 자랑이야.

english_expression: We were so close to making the deadline but missed it by an hour.
korean_translation: 마감을 딱 맞출 뻔했는데 한 시간 차이로 놓쳤어.

english_expression: Don't take your health for granted. You'll regret it later.
korean_translation: 건강을 당연하게 여기지 마. 나중에 후회해.

english_expression: Before this gets worse let's set things straight between us.
korean_translation: 더 악화되기 전에 우리 사이에 오해를 풀자.

english_expression: I was so tempted to skip the gym this morning.
korean_translation: 오늘 아침에 헬스장 빠질까 하는 생각이 너무 들었어.

english_expression: Her silence speaks volumes. She must be upset.
korean_translation: 그녀의 침묵이 많은 걸 말해줘. 화가 난 게 분명해.

english_expression: Writing is my bread and butter. I've been doing it for 10 years.
korean_translation: 글쓰기가 내 생계야. 10년 동안 해왔거든.

english_expression: Money-wise, this deal doesn't make much sense.
korean_translation: 돈 측면에서 보면 이 거래는 별로 이득이 없어.

english_expression: It took me a while to adjust to the new work schedule.
korean_translation: 새 근무 일정에 적응하는 데 시간이 좀 걸렸어.
